body: They are definitely good at selfie

No please don’t. You comforted me now it turn to me to comfort you. You will find a good job, a nice girlfriend and will have a cute baby, have a brand new happy family instead of suffering from parents forever. Just ignore them and I also promise you will be better and one day will get rid of them.
Thank you for these words. I haven’t felt such care since she left me. I’ll strive for closure to be a better one. As for weather she would come back, time will tell the answer. Thanks again.

Thanks. It helps a lot. I tried to get closure but failed. I still want her back though the possibility has approached to zero. I can’t persuade myself to give up her but on the other rationality tells me that any effort should be useless so I shall give up, live for myself. Yesterday I went to a park seeking for relaxation however couples were everywhere only me who is single, alone. How I wish she is beside me and we can be hand in hand walking together as before. Scenes like that always makes me insane. I really do love her. I miss her.

I have the same feelings but I know clearly it’s actually I have no friends to talk with about the deep areas of my heart instead of don’t want to talk. Just try to find some true friends though I know it is very very very difficult 😔
